description: This Java source file defines an abstract class HL7QueueItem which models a generic HL7 message queue item in the OpenMRS system, including fields for source, key, data, and creation date, with persistence annotations.

classes.name: HL7QueueItem
classes.description: An abstract base class representing a queue item for HL7 messages, including source, data, and timestamp fields, with ORM annotations for database persistence.

methods.name: getDateCreated
methods.description: Returns the date when the HL7 queue item was created.

methods.name: setDateCreated
methods.description: Sets the creation date for the HL7 queue item.

methods.name: getHL7Data
methods.description: Retrieves the HL7 message data stored in the queue item.

methods.name: setHL7Data
methods.description: Sets the HL7 message data for the queue item.

methods.name: getHL7Source
methods.description: Returns the source of the HL7 message.

methods.name: setHL7Source
methods.description: Sets the source of the HL7 message.

methods.name: getHL7SourceKey
methods.description: Retrieves the key associated with the HL7 source.

methods.name: setHL7SourceKey
methods.description: Sets the key associated with the HL7 source.
